args.subject: Recommendation: Cascade Falls Trail (great weekend hike)
args.body:
Hi Frank,

I wanted to recommend Cascade Falls Trail in the national park — it’s perfect for weekend hikes. It’s about 3 miles round trip and offers beautiful waterfall views along the way. A great short, scenic outing.

If you’d like, I can send directions or suggest the best times to go.

Best regards,

args.subject: Recommendation: The Artisan Bakery (sourdough!)
args.body:
Hi Grace,

I wanted to recommend The Artisan Bakery downtown — their sourdough bread is incredible. They bake fresh every morning at 6 AM, so it’s best to stop by early if you want the freshest loaves.

Would you like directions or a specific recommendation from their menu?

Best regards,
